strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
...We've joined up with the allied forces.@What about the Hiryu Custom?
Still fighting in the streets of Berlin.
Then request reinforcements from that unit...
Multiple gravity quake readings overhead!@ES Wave Pattern, <Zovorg>!
One unregistered unit! It's a large mobile weapon!
Incoming transmission from the Gadisword unit!
This is Vort Nikolaus of the Gadisword Army.@Hear me. Hand over the <Ariard> aboard that ship...
...along with Fairy Kribia, Sieg Altreet@and Sally Emil.
If this demand is not accepted,@we will take them back by force.
Sergeant Major Azuki, put me through.
This is Miles Boothroyd, commander of@the Earth Federation Army's <Steel Dragons>. Do you have@proof that what you demand is aboard this ship?
If I didn't, I wouldn't be here. What is your answer?
I can't answer right away.@I'll need to consult the proper authorities.
I won't let you stall. I'll take that as a refusal.
Then I can't guarantee the lives of the three@Gadisword people. And we'll destroy Ariard too.
...That's fine. The three deserters will be executed@either way. And my orders are to destroy Ariard@if it can't be recovered.
I had hoped to avoid a fight if at all possible,@but I judge that talks have broken down. Attacking.
Roger. All guns, prepare for anti-air combat.
(That man Vort... He was sure Ariard was aboard@and launched a surprise attack, so why did he@open a channel...?)
(...Sounds like another battle's started.@Ever since I got put on this ship, it's been one fight@after another. Busy bunch, I swear.)
What's with you guys?@I'm not up to anything shady.
We've been ordered to increase security on you.@Please bear with us for a while.
That's weird.@You're watching me all the time anyway.@Why increase security?
(Could the ones attacking right now be...)
Don't be stupid!@We've only just attached the Booster,@the servomotors are still the stock ones!
In the worst case, it could stop moving...@You two should know that well.
But almost all the Steel Dragons' units are out!@We're the only ones who can stop that new guy now!
The enemy's capabilities are unknown, and your unit@isn't fully tuned... You're clearly at a disadvantage.@If you still want to sortie, remove the uncertainties.
You mean take off the Saber Booster?
If we return the settings to normal, it'll be stable, but...
Do we have time for that?!@If the Hagane goes down, it's all over!
Before that, there's no guarantee@Soul Saber will even hold up!
Mogami's <Mighty Walker> is all about being tough@and reliable! I believe in the Soul Saber@you built, Jinpu!
Me too...@I'll buy time with Akimi until the Hiryu Custom arrives.
Count on us, Jinpu!@We're gonna save the day,@with Mogami's Mighty Walker!
...All right. All right, but you're only buying time.@Don't do anything reckless, got it?
...That takes care of most of them.
Ngh!@Don't we have any units we can send out?!
All units, eliminate the remaining enemies and@surround the Hagane. I'll retrieve Ariard myself.
Golf 1 closing in on us fast!
P-Put up a barrage! Don't let it near!
The front of the No. 2 catapult hatch@was blown off! The jacks are wrecked too!@The catapult can't be closed!
Could it be planning to break into the ship@through the No. 2 catapult?!
Th-Thicken the barrage! Don't let it get close!
Akemi, how's the load on the servomotors?!
We're going in without a test run, but we'll manage!@With this Super Soul Saber!
I did not authorize a sortie!
Commander, I think we should leave this to them.
Hmm... I suppose there's no choice.
Listen, Akimi!@Push the output too high and the servomotors'll blow!@Keep it at 80... no, 70%!
Akimi, we can't use the Hyper Blast Sword.@The Twin Long Cannon isn't tuned either,@so its accuracy is low. Be careful.
Akimi, transmission from the Gadisword unit!
Are Fairy, Sieg and Sally@aboard your ship?
We have no intention of answering your questions!
That's right!@Whatever you're scheming, we'll stop you!
Then I'll show no mercy either.
Captain, message from Dragon 2!@They've repelled the enemy in Berlin@and are hurrying here!
How long until they reach the battle zone?
Support the Super Soul Saber.@Hold out until the Hiryu Custom arrives.
Dragon 2 has reached the battle zone!
Whoa, Soul Saber's got wings now.@So you got your power-up, huh?
Yeah, but it's not fully tuned yet.
(...So the Hiryu Custom has come.@To think they'd break through the double@holding action so quickly.)
We didn't see that unit@when we went to Rabulpaila.
It has big thrusters instead of legs...?
Yes, looks like it's built for space combat.
Carrying a scythe... What, does it think it's the Reaper?
Makes it easy to guess what sort of moves@it'll use, though.
(The <Golaikunru> provided data@on the Steel Dragons... but let me see@their abilities for myself.)
Eleve 1 to all units! Commence attack!
(...No sign of them coming out.@If there's a reaction, it'll be next time.)
The enemy unit is withdrawing from the battle zone!
If Akimi and Akemi hadn't gone out,@it would have been close.
...I know.@Their unauthorized sortie will be offset@by their service in saving this ship.
However, give them a stern warning.
Commander, I believe we should return to Berlin@and make confirming the Lamaris purification a priority.
Yes, you're right.@After recovering all units, head to Berlin@at normal cruising.
Akimi, it might have more power than us!@Be careful not to get baited into max output!
Right, it's the Super Soul Saber's first battle!@I'll throw all my grit and guts into stopping him!
(Your attitude tells me everything.@Fairy and the others are on the Hagane.)
That thing's pretty fast for its size...!
We both excel at close combat.@Then the Gyanonia Ogre will not lose.
The Hagane almost got taken out.@We owe Akimi and Akemi big time!
Caught off guard and overwhelmed...@So I still haven't fully mastered this unit.
Using big thrusters to dive into the enemy's guard...@It's a unit with a concept similar to the Alt.
Steel Dragons... Let me see your abilities@for myself.
It was a violation of orders,@but Akimi and Akemi's judgment saved us...!
I wanted to finish this before the Hiryu Custom@returned, but it can't be helped now.
A unit we've never encountered... I must get data on it.
No problems even fighting under gravity.@<Rattma> technology really is superior.
A new Gadisword model...@If it closes in for melee with that acceleration,@it's dangerous.
Now that it's been given to me, I'll master it...!
Its acceleration and response are way better@than other Gadisword units...!@But I won't lose a high-mobility fight!
According to the data, it's a mobile weapon@with some of the top speed on Earth...@A worthy opponent.
Jeez... I was wondering what'd happen,@but I'm glad you made it back in one piece.
Told you, didn't I? I believe in the Soul Saber@you built, Jinpu.
But in its current state, there's no next time.@I'm taking it apart right away and replacing@all the joint servomotors.
Either way, we won't be able to sortie for a while...
I saw that, Akimi.@With those wings, it looks even cooler!
Big wings really are the classic power-up.@I want wings like that on the SRX too.
Yeah... I want to add cannons too.
Good idea, but that'd overlap with@the R-2 Powered and the R-Gun Powered.
Speaking of cannons...@Soul Saber's back booster is kind of like@the G Compati Kaiser's in that way.
Well, sure, the Saber Booster has@some of Kisaburo's ideas in it.
Could it act on its own,@like the G-Thundergate?
Someday. Right now we're prioritizing tuning it@as Soul Saber's flight unit. So it can't fly@on its own.
Is this about our unauthorized sortie?
I've been told to give you a stern warning about that...@but first, there's questioning regarding@Vort Nikolaus. Come with me.
...Vort Nikolaus is from <Anex>.@He's Sally's and my superior officer.
And he's an ace pilot of the Anex regular army.
(I'd better not say anything unnecessary here...)
Vort Nikolaus launched a surprise attack, yet he still@opened a channel and demanded we hand over Ariard@and the three of you.
Had he not done so, he might at least@have recovered or destroyed the former.
What's more, he asked Akimi and Akemi@where you were.
I see.@Well, even if he took us back to Rabulpaila,@Herluga would just execute us.
Vort said as much, but...@judging from his words and actions, it seems@he was trying to make contact with you.
Are you two spies posing as deserters@after all?
Sally and Sieg fought Crystal Dragoon when@it attacked Aviano Base, and they haven't done@anything suspicious since coming aboard the Hagane!
...So what you're saying is this.@We've been spying on this ship and@we plan to report to Captain Vort.
With my movements restricted and me under watch,@you think I could pull something like that off?
You could still pass on whatever you've seen.
Then don't keep us on this ship.@Lock us up in a cell on some base instead.
...We deserted to learn the truth Herluga@is hiding... to expose the conspiracy between@that man and Golaikunru...
Me too... Knowing full well that I can't go@home until everything comes to light and true@peace is made between Gadisword and Earth...
Otherwise, I wouldn't help you analyze the Ariard.
Then why, despite the execution order,@is Vort Nikolaus trying@to make contact with you?
Maybe he means to execute us with his own hands.@If he didn't, Herluga would probably get suspicious.
Vort Nikolaus should be serving Malum Quisude.@So why is he following@Herluga instead?
We were thinking Fairy might@know something, but...
...If I knew, I would tell you.
Then let me ask this. If Vort Nikolaus appears again@and urges you to return to Rabulpaila, what will you do?
...I have no intention of going back with him.
Same here. I'm not going back knowing I'll be executed.
Then let me change the question.@Could you fight Vort Nikolaus...@and your fellow people of Rabulpaila?
If that would help stop the war@between Gadisword and Earth...
(That may be the only way@to learn what Vort really intends...)
...That's enough. Take these three back.@And under no circumstances let up on the surveillance.
I'm told Lieutenant Calvina has regained consciousness.
Then, about the matter we discussed earlier...
Commander, there's something I'd like to@report to you somewhere else.
...If you're here to visit, don't bother.@As you can see, I'm fine.
What are you talking about, with all those braces on?
That's right. Please don't push yourself.
You're hardly one to talk, are you?
But my injuries are lighter than yours, Calvina...
I'm not hurt as badly as you, Calvina.
That's right. You mustn't push yourself.
By the way, what about the Bellzelute?@Can it be repaired?
...In that condition, even if we took it to the maker,@I think it would be pretty tough.
Yeah, <Ashurey Kreuzer> has@a branch in Germany.
That branch only builds construction machinery.@Repairs are out of the question either way. I'll need@a replacement. A single-seat <Armored Module> would do.
That's right. That way I can fight without holding back.
Lieutenant,@don't you think you should rest for a while?
Josh told me the same thing, but I don't have@that kind of time. Not as long as Al-Van is alive.
Getting a replacement unit will take time.@Three days at the very least.
Lieutenant Calvina, I need a word.
I'd like you to come with me to Ashurey Kreuzer's@German branch, starting now.@It concerns the Bellzelute.
I heard it was damaged so badly that even the maker@couldn't repair it. Besides, the German branch...
A new Bellzelute is being developed there.
I said a new Bellzelute is being developed@at Ashurey's German branch.
